true-war.title: True War Banner
true-war.skillIdentity: Aggressive valiance — press fights, break lines, and dominate ranked PvP.

branchPaths.name: Ferocious Line
branchPaths.summary: Break enemy lines with infantry damage spikes and relentless front-line pressure.

branchPaths.name: Higher Ground
branchPaths.summary: Punish stronger-ranked armies and win duels where Valiance matters most.

branchPaths.name: Relentless Valiance
branchPaths.summary: Chain attacks, tempo swings, and wounded-unit ferocity to keep the offensive alive.

sachiels-blessing.title: Sachiel's Blessing Banner
sachiels-blessing.skillIdentity: Restoration & army sustain — revive losses and recover after every fight.

branchPaths.name: Revitalization Surge
branchPaths.summary: Bring injured units back from the brink during and after combat.

branchPaths.name: Restored Vigour
branchPaths.summary: Heal, reinforce, and harden armies between engagements.

branchPaths.name: Angelic March
branchPaths.summary: Keep armies moving with bonus march tempo and recovery on the road.

branchPaths.name: Phalanx Hold
branchPaths.summary: Hold battle lines with mixed-unit defense, damage reduction, and defensive fighting rounds.

branchPaths.name: Rampart Reserve
branchPaths.summary: Stretch your gold, recover after losses, and keep your army funded on the map.

branchPaths.name: Sentinel Screen
branchPaths.summary: Misdirect enemy intel, march faster to allies, and hold your own defensive battles.

nodes.name: Phalanx Pledge
nodes.description: Your whole army takes 5% less damage in battle.
nodes.counterplay: Hit their weakest unit type first.

nodes.name: Phalanx Foundation
nodes.description: If your army has two unit types, both take 20% less damage. With three unit types, enemy counter-attacks deal 25% less damage.
nodes.counterplay: Break their unit mix or finish counter-attacks before they stack defense.

nodes.name: Layered Deflection
nodes.description: Your Cavalry takes 20% less damage from piercing and magic attacks.
nodes.counterplay: Use Ranged and Beasts against their Cavalry before the cavalry round.

nodes.name: Shrapnel Screen
nodes.description: If enemy Ranged hurt you in round 1, your Ranged hits back 20% harder.
nodes.counterplay: Shut down their Ranged in round 1.

nodes.name: Aegis Conduit
nodes.description: The more Ranged you keep alive, the better your Beasts block damage.
nodes.counterplay: Kill their Ranged early to weaken their Beasts.

nodes.name: Integrated Guard
nodes.description: When one unit type drops below 40% health, your other unit types take 15% less damage.
nodes.counterplay: Finish off a wounded group before the rest get tougher.

nodes.name: Anchor Formation
nodes.description: Your Cavalry always fights in the right battle round—it cannot be skipped or pushed aside.
nodes.counterplay: Win the Ranged and Beast rounds so their Cavalry never matters.

nodes.name: Stalemate Mastery
nodes.description: Each Infantry fighting round adds +3% defense. This stacks every round.
nodes.counterplay: End the fight fast—do not let Infantry drag on.

nodes.name: Hold the Breach
nodes.description: When your army defends, your Beasts take 25% less damage during the Beast fighting round.
nodes.counterplay: Win the Ranged and Cavalry rounds before Beasts matter.

nodes.name: Phalanx Apex
nodes.description: When your army defends, your Infantry gets +25% armor and +20% max health.
nodes.counterplay: Force the fight on your terms—attack before they settle into defense.

nodes.name: Bastion Reserve
nodes.description: Saved for a future update. No effect right now.
nodes.counterplay: None.

nodes.name: Logistics Reserve
nodes.description: Gold spent on army expenses costs 12% less.
nodes.counterplay: Keep pressure on so they cannot bank savings forever.

nodes.name: Sentinel Sentry
nodes.description: When you defend in battle, your army takes 5% less damage.
nodes.counterplay: Attack before they can settle into a defensive fight.

nodes.name: War Chest Salvage
nodes.description: After battles you lose, you recover 20% of the army wages you spent in that fight.
nodes.counterplay: Keep winning—salvage only helps after defeats.

nodes.name: Border Warden
nodes.description: When fighting on your nation's border tiles, your army can deploy 15% more of your own troops.
nodes.counterplay: Attack before they finish mustering on the border.

nodes.name: Defensive Mobilization
nodes.description: When you march to assist an ally on your nation's map, it costs you 30% fewer Move Points.
nodes.counterplay: Cut off reinforcements before they arrive.

nodes.name: Counter-Intelligence
nodes.description: Enemies scouting you see fake army numbers—they cannot read your real unit mix.
nodes.counterplay: Scout again or fight them to learn their true army.

nodes.name: Rapid Redeploy
nodes.description: Spend 1 Move Point to march directly to an ally's battle within your map sight range.
nodes.counterplay: Cut off their march before they can join the fight.

nodes.name: Steadfast Rally
nodes.description: Your army recovers morale 20% faster between battles.
nodes.counterplay: Chain attacks before their morale recovers.

nodes.name: Watchtower Network
nodes.description: Moving through your nation's land ignores enemy slowdown effects.
nodes.counterplay: Block key routes instead of relying on movement penalties.

nodes.name: Exposed Flank
nodes.description: When your army defends, enemies using only one unit type deal 15% less damage to you.
nodes.counterplay: Bring a mixed army instead of one unit type only.

nodes.name: Iron Curtain
nodes.description: When your army defends on your nation's map, you take 15% less damage in battle.
nodes.counterplay: Fight them outside their homeland or force them to attack.

nodes.name: Moral Anchor
nodes.description: When a unit type is wiped out, your army's morale drop is cut in half.
nodes.counterplay: Destroy several groups in the same round.

nodes.name: Sovereign Phalanx
nodes.description: Mixed armies are easier to field—a unit type only needs 10% of your army (not 15%) to count as active.
nodes.counterplay: Still punish fake mixed armies built from tiny unit stacks.

costModel.summary: Each next purchased skill costs 1 additional banner point (1st purchase = 1 pt, 2nd = 2 pts, and so on). Keystone auto-unlocks for free.

fortunes-gratitude.title: Fortune's Gratitude Banner
fortunes-gratitude.skillIdentity: Economic prosperity & trade — merchant growth, tick income, and war dividends.

branchPaths.name: Merchant Tithe
branchPaths.summary: Grow wealth every tick and compound merchant reserves over time.

branchPaths.name: Victory Dividend
branchPaths.summary: Convert battlefield wins into currency and post-victory payouts.

branchPaths.name: Hinshuro Ledger
branchPaths.summary: Shrink army and city costs so trade income outpaces upkeep.
